reasoning_summary: The bug report indicates that the accuracy of the special functions is limited by a hardcoded epsilon value. Correcting this requires changing the algorithm's convergence threshold (the epsilon parameter) used in the calculation of these functions. This is a classic example of an algorithm efficiency/correctness problem where the implementation of the numerical method needs adjustment to meet the expected precision requirements.
